title: Aircraft instruments go haywire at edge of the bubble

tellings.quote: We've even had fixed-wing aircraft that actually document that there's something that their their instruments their instruments go haywire.

plain: Instruments on fixed-wing planes flying over Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, a property known for reports of strange happenings, are said to go haywire when they reach the edge of an invisible zone over the land that people there call "the bubble." The owner of the ranch says this on the show as something his team has seen and recorded: the planes "actually document that there's something." If true, it would mean that whatever is at the ranch has a physical edge that machines can detect.
